Basic colors

Ready — try the example.

States and behavior

Swatches, RGB values, preview draft, committed well, validation and cancel rollback.

Keyboard

Tab reaches the palette and numeric fields; arrows select a palette color; Up/Down or the up-down buttons edit components; Escape cancels.

Scope and adaptation

A deliberately small browser color dialog. It does not emulate the native Windows custom-color store, hue/saturation plane, system palette or color management.

Sources

Microsoft preliminary guide (1995), chapters 7–8 · Modern browser accessibility pattern

Original implementation; the page uses the shared GUI95 stylesheet with its 11px Tahoma stack. The 1995 source is preliminary, not a final product specification. Test the target browser and native host before shipping.
